beats.summary: Pam reveals to Michael that someone still has feelings for him, though she cannot share specifics.

evidence.snippet: Pam: She still has feelings for you.
Pam: I can't tell you specifically, but… it's not over.

beats.summary: Kelly's coworkers surprise her with a birthday cake and a theme allowing her to choose an hour of TV or napping at work.

evidence.snippet:
Kelly (enters conference room):
All: Happy Birthday!
Jim: Because the fun part is, you get to decide on an hour of television, or an hour of napping.

beats.summary: Kelly chooses to take a nap for her birthday hour, and her coworkers clear the room for her to rest.

evidence.snippet: Kelly: You know what, I have been watching TV all week. I choose nap.
Dwight: Okay, nap it is! Everyone out! Get out! We're gonna be eating cake at our desks.

beats.summary: Dwight wakes Kelly loudly after her nap and tells her to make up for the work she missed.

evidence.snippet: Dwight (opens door to wake Kelly, bangs together two trash can covers loudly): Birthday time is over!

beats.summary: Michael humorously insults a man named Tony from Stamford, deciding he cannot apologize due to Tony's size.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Jabba the hut, Pizza the hut, Fat guys like pizza, pepperoni pizza, pepperoni Tony!
Michael: Man, was he fat. So, so… fat.
